name: German WW1 column-mounted throttle lever (Fokker D.VII / Pfalz D.III)
view: the column head from the left side, as the pilot sees it; forward is left: the left handgrip seen end-on, the throttle lever pivoting on the column just below the triggers with its small knob and the sector it moves along
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the column head's outline and the throttle lever reconstructed from the IL-2 Great Battles / Flying Circus Fokker D.VII, D.VIIF and Pfalz D.IIIa notes and public museum and replica cockpit photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
